Nha Trang, the famous coastal city of Khanh Hoa Province, has long been a dream destination for millions of domestic and international travelers. Beyond its long sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, Nha Trang is renowned for its collection of stunning islands, each offering its own unique charm and unforgettable experiences.

If you are planning a trip to Nha Trang and wish to explore pristine nature, turquoise seas, and authentic island life, this guide will introduce you to the most beautiful islands you should not miss.

Overview Of Island Tourism In Nha Trang

Located within one of the most beautiful bays in the world, Nha Trang boasts a diverse archipelago of islands that create a breathtaking and poetic seascape. These islands are not only ideal for water sports and marine activities but also perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, cultural discovery, and fresh seafood.

Island tourism in Nha Trang goes beyond swimming and sunbathing. It is a journey into fishing village life, marine conservation efforts, and the rich coastal culture of central Vietnam. Thanks to its diverse ecosystems and well-developed tourism services, Nha Trang remains a year-round island paradise.

The Most Beautiful Islands In Nha Trang You Should Not Miss

Diep Son Island – The Unique Sand Path In The Sea

Located in Van Phong Bay, Diep Son Island is famous for its natural white sand pathway stretching nearly 700 meters, emerging in the middle of the sea during low tide. The path connects three small islands and allows visitors to walk between them with clear seawater on both sides.

This rare natural phenomenon offers a once-in-a-lifetime experience and has become a favorite destination for adventurous travelers and photographers. Beyond the sand path, Diep Son charms visitors with its untouched beaches and peaceful fishing village atmosphere.

Best time to visit: December to June
Boat transfer: From Van Gia Port, approximately 150,000–200,000 VND per person (round trip)

Yen Island (Hon Noi) – Home Of The Precious Swiftlets

Yen Island, also known as Hon Noi, is considered one of the most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay. Its highlight is Vietnam’s only double beach, where one side has warm water and the other cool water.

The island is home to thousands of swiftlets and plays a vital role in Vietnam’s traditional bird’s nest harvesting industry. Visitors can explore caves, snorkel among coral reefs, and learn about this centuries-old craft.

Best time to visit: March to September
Tour price: Approximately 350,000–450,000 VND per person (limited daily visitors)

Binh Ba Island – The Lobster Paradise

Binh Ba Island, located in Cam Ranh Bay, is famous for its affordable, fresh lobster and pristine beaches such as Bai Nom, Bai Chuong, and Bai Bo De. Life on the island remains simple and peaceful, offering a perfect escape from city crowds.

Visitors can enjoy snorkeling, fishing, and especially seafood dining directly sourced from local fishermen.

Note: Binh Ba Island is currently open only to Vietnamese citizens
Best time to visit: March to September
Boat ticket: 30,000–50,000 VND from Ba Ngoi Port

Binh Hung Island – A Hidden Gem Of Cam Ranh

Binh Hung Island, part of the Tam Binh Islands, is known for its crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and untouched natural beauty. Often called the “mini Maldives of Vietnam,” this island offers excellent snorkeling right from the shore.

Visitors can explore the island by motorbike, visit Hon Chut Lighthouse, and enjoy fresh seafood such as grilled squid, sea snails, and seafood mini pancakes.

Best time to visit: Summer months
Boat transfer: 10–15 minutes from Da Bac Port

Hon Mun Island – Vietnam’s First Marine Protected Area

Hon Mun is the most famous snorkeling and diving destination in Nha Trang. Recognized as Vietnam’s first marine reserve, it is home to over 1,500 species of coral and marine life.

Visitors can enjoy scuba diving, snorkeling, glass-bottom boat tours, and swimming in crystal-clear waters while learning about marine conservation.

Best time to visit: April to September
Tour price: 250,000–500,000 VND per person (half-day tours)

Hon Tam Island – Luxury Resort Escape

Unlike other rustic islands, Hon Tam offers a premium resort experience. It features long white-sand beaches, hot mineral mud baths, spa services, water sports, and fine dining restaurants.

This island is ideal for travelers seeking relaxation, wellness, and upscale amenities in a tropical setting.

Best time to visit: March to September
Entrance packages: From 300,000 to over 1,000,000 VND depending on services

Monkey Island (Hon Lao) – A Kingdom Of Monkeys

Monkey Island is home to thousands of freely roaming monkeys. Visitors can interact with them, enjoy animal shows, and relax on shaded beaches. This island is especially suitable for families with children.

Best time to visit: March to September
Entrance ticket: Around 150,000 VND per person (includes boat transfer)

Hon Tre Island – Home Of VinWonders Nha Trang

Hon Tre is the largest island in Nha Trang Bay and home to VinWonders Nha Trang, a world-class amusement complex featuring water parks, roller coasters, aquariums, and live shows.

Accessible by one of the world’s longest oversea cable cars, Hon Tre is perfect for families and travelers seeking vibrant entertainment.

Best time to visit: January to September
VinWonders ticket: Approximately 800,000–1,000,000 VND per person

Important Tips When Visiting Nha Trang Islands

  • Bring sun protection: hats, sunglasses, sunscreen

  • Wear light, quick-dry clothing

  • Carry cash for small island services

  • Book island tours in advance during peak season

  • Respect marine life and coral reefs

  • Check weather forecasts before departure

  • Prepare motion sickness medication if needed

Nha Trang Island Cuisine – Fresh Flavors Of The Sea

  • Binh Ba lobster

  • Various sea snails

  • Grilled grouper and cobia fish

  • Raw Mai fish salad

  • Sea urchin dishes

  • Seafood pancakes and mini rice cakes

  • One-sun-dried squid

Suggested 3 Day 2 Night Island Itinerary

Day 1: Hon Mun snorkeling – Floating fishing village – Nha Trang night market
Day 2: Diep Son or Binh Hung / Binh Ba Island exploration
Day 3: Relax at Hon Tam or enjoy VinWonders on Hon Tre Island

With its stunning islands, diverse experiences, and rich coastal culture, Nha Trang is a true island paradise. Whether you seek relaxation, adventure, luxury, or authentic island life, the islands of Nha Trang have something for everyone.

Planning an island tour in Nha Trang is the perfect way to experience the beauty of Vietnam’s central coastline and create unforgettable travel memories.
